استذمين (form X)
# اِسْتَذْمَيْنَ (istaḏmayna) /is.tað.maj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# اُسْتُذْمِينَ (ustuḏmīna) /us.tuð.miː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
# اِسْتَذْمِينَ (istaḏmīna) /is.tað.miː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَذْمَى (istaḏmā)
